trust_decision.summary: Index code trusts that every indexed/query value has the dimension recorded for the index (column atttypmod at build, metapage dimensions afterwards); fixed-size k-means buffers are sized from that dimension while per-type sumCenter loops trust the value's own dim header, and VectorArraySet only rejects values larger than itemsize, so smaller/mismatched values are accepted.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'buffer overflow in IVFFlat index build'; AddSample copies sampled values into the fixed-itemsize VectorArray that k-means then sums into per-center rows.
